changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: lib-jobs adoption (2/3): copy existing JOBS.LOG text into a staging column before the lib-jobs library changelog drops JOBS.LOG and creates JOB_LOGS (see lib-jobs DESIGN.md 8). The library's own changeset creates JOB_LOGS and drops JOBS.LOG in one atomic changeset, so the copy has to happen before it runs, not in between.

sql.sql: UPDATE JOBS SET LOG_BACKFILL = LOG WHERE LOG IS NOT NULL
